name: Hex
blurb: A Hex API key: mix hex.publish, owners and private packages.
guide: On this machine, run mix hex.user key generate --key-name agent-sandbox --permission api:write, or create a key at hex.pm/dashboard/keys.
Prefer a key limited to the packages the agent publishes.
Paste it below. In the VM, mwt exec CREDENTIAL -- mix … supplies the placeholder as HEX_API_KEY only to that command.

fields.purpose: My Hex key: publishing packages and reading private ones.
